name: Four-Week Running Calibration — Patched
description: Four-week daily running calibration bundle starting 2026-06-29. Patched to require Garmin chest-strap HR for calibration-quality data, remove Week 1 steady work, and add one optional diagnostic LTHR calibration test in Week 3. Weekly targets: Week 1: 46.5 mi, strap validation and easy-only baseline, 1 stride day, no steady/threshold, 1 long easy run; Week 2: 48.0 mi, small extension with first controlled aerobic check, 1 stride day, 1 easy-to-steady progression if strap data is clean, 1 long run; Week 3: 49.0 mi, highest calibration load plus optional diagnostic LTHR test, 1 stride day, 1 optional LTHR test or fallback steady audit, 1 long run; Week 4: 42.5 mi, deload, zone review, and next-block decision, reduced stride dose, short steady check only if fresh, reduced long run

card_templates.name: Recovery Run
card_templates.summary: Very easy run used to restore legs while preserving the daily running habit.

payload.instructions: Workout type: recovery. RPE: 1-2. Talk test: Full conversation; effort should feel almost too easy. HR guidance: During calibration, do not chase Garmin zones. Record them after. Use Garmin chest strap for calibration-quality HR; if using wrist HR, log the run as non-calibration-quality.

exercises.label: Settle in
exercises.detail: Start slower than instinct. Let breathing and cadence normalize.

exercises.label: Recovery mileage
exercises.detail: Keep the run soft, relaxed, and deliberately unambitious.

exercises.label: Walk reset
exercises.detail: Walk until breathing is calm before logging notes.

card_templates.name: Easy Aerobic Run
card_templates.summary: Default Zone-2-by-feel run for aerobic base and calibration.

payload.instructions: Workout type: easy. RPE: 2-3. Talk test: Full sentences. You should not need mental toughness. HR guidance: Use RPE and talk test first. Garmin zones are audit data until calibrated. Use Garmin chest strap for calibration-quality HR; if using wrist HR, log the run as non-calibration-quality.

exercises.label: Easy start
exercises.detail: First mile slower than average pace. Do not correct upward.

exercises.label: Aerobic cruise
exercises.detail: Hold relaxed breathing and posture. Pace is secondary.

exercises.label: Easy finish
exercises.detail: Finish no harder than the middle of the run.

card_templates.name: Easy Run + Strides
card_templates.summary: Easy aerobic run with relaxed fast strides for mechanics, cadence, and leg pop.

payload.instructions: Workout type: easy_plus_strides. RPE: 2-3 aerobic; strides fast but relaxed. Talk test: Easy during the run; strides are too short to judge by talk test. HR guidance: Ignore HR during strides. Use full recovery and judge form. Use Garmin chest strap for calibration-quality HR; if using wrist HR, log the run as non-calibration-quality.

exercises.label: Easy running
exercises.detail: Run easy first. Do not let anticipation of strides raise the pace.

exercises.label: Strides
exercises.detail: Fast-relaxed, tall posture, quick feet. Walk/jog 60-90s between.

exercises.label: Cooldown jog
exercises.detail: Easy jog home. Calves should not feel cooked.

card_templates.name: Easy Run + Form Drills
card_templates.summary: Easy aerobic run followed by short mechanics drills for posture and coordination.

payload.instructions: Workout type: easy_plus_drills. RPE: 2-3. Talk test: Easy run remains conversational; drills stay crisp. HR guidance: Drills are technique, not conditioning. Use Garmin chest strap for calibration-quality HR; if using wrist HR, log the run as non-calibration-quality.

exercises.label: Easy run
exercises.detail: Relaxed aerobic mileage.

exercises.label: A-skips
exercises.detail: Tall posture, quick ground contact, no stomping.

exercises.label: High knees
exercises.detail: Rhythm and posture over height.

exercises.label: Butt kicks
exercises.detail: Quick turnover; keep knees under hips.

exercises.label: Straight-leg bounds
exercises.detail: Light snap from the hips and ankles, not max power.

card_templates.name: Steady Aerobic Check
card_templates.summary: Controlled aerobic run for calibrating easy-versus-steady effort without threshold work.

payload.instructions: Workout type: steady_aerobic. RPE: 3-4. Talk test: Sentences possible. If you are reduced to phrases, back off. HR guidance: This is useful for mapping Garmin zones, but do not force HR into a prescribed zone. Use Garmin chest strap for calibration-quality HR; if using wrist HR, log the run as non-calibration-quality.

exercises.label: Easy warmup
exercises.detail: Ease into the run; do not start steady.

exercises.label: Controlled steady block
exercises.detail: Steady aerobic pressure, never threshold. Keep breathing controlled.

exercises.label: Easy cooldown
exercises.detail: Return to conversational running.

card_templates.name: Easy-to-Steady Progression
card_templates.summary: Easy run that finishes slightly steadier only when the body gives permission.

payload.instructions: Workout type: aerobic_progression. RPE: 2-4. Talk test: Full sentences early; controlled sentences near the end. HR guidance: Let HR be observed, not targeted. Use Garmin chest strap for calibration-quality HR; if using wrist HR, log the run as non-calibration-quality.

exercises.label: Easy first half
exercises.detail: Stay in true easy effort.

exercises.label: Optional steady finish
exercises.detail: Only drift to steady if legs and breathing are good. No tempo.

exercises.label: Easy finish
exercises.detail: Back off before stopping.

card_templates.name: Long Easy Run
card_templates.summary: Comfortable long run for aerobic durability and HR-drift calibration.

payload.instructions: Workout type: long_easy. RPE: 2-3. Talk test: Full sentences for most of the run. Last 20 minutes may require focus but not strain. HR guidance: Use this to audit drift. Do not chase a faster finish during calibration. Use Garmin chest strap for calibration-quality HR; if using wrist HR, log the run as non-calibration-quality.

exercises.label: Conservative start
exercises.detail: Start slower than expected. First 20 min should feel trivial.

exercises.label: Aerobic duration
exercises.detail: Comfortable rhythm. Fuel/hydrate if needed.

exercises.label: Controlled finish
exercises.detail: Maintain form without pressing pace.

card_templates.name: Weekly Running Calibration Review
card_templates.summary: Weekly audit of RPE, Garmin zones, fatigue, and next-week adjustment signals.

payload.instructions: Use this after the final recovery run of each week. The goal is not judgment; the goal is better signal.

items.label: What pace range actually felt easy this week?
Where did Garmin zones disagree with talk test/RPE?
Any calf, Achilles, hamstring, knee, hip, or foot signals?
Heat, sleep, work stress, hydration notes?

card_templates.name: HR Strap Calibration Setup
card_templates.summary: Pre-run checklist to make HR data usable for zone calibration.

payload.instructions: Use this before the first run and repeat mentally before every calibration run. The point is not gadget obedience; the point is clean data.

items.label: Wear Garmin chest strap
items.detail: Wet the electrodes, tighten the strap enough that it does not slide, and pair it before starting the run.

items.label: Verify HR source
items.detail: Confirm the watch is reading from the strap, not wrist optical HR.

items.label: Watch for early spikes
items.detail: If HR jumps unrealistically in the first 5-10 minutes, reseat the strap and mark the run as partial calibration quality.

items.label: Log calibration quality
items.detail: After the run, record strap used yes/no, signal quality, RPE, talk test, and Garmin zone mismatch.

card_templates.name: Optional LTHR Calibration Test
card_templates.summary: One diagnostic lactate-threshold HR calibration test after 10-14 days of clean strap data.

payload.instructions: Workout type: diagnostic_lthr_test. RPE: Progressive to hard-controlled; never all-out sprinting. Talk test: Final 30-minute field-test portion should be short phrases only, but controlled enough to avoid blowing up. HR guidance: Chest strap required. Preferred option is Garmin guided Lactate Threshold Test if available. Fallback is the 30-minute field test below. Do not use wrist HR for this test. Readiness gate: At least 10 days of mostly clean chest-strap HR data; No calf/Achilles/hamstring/knee pain above mild background noise; No unusual fatigue, illness, poor sleep, or heat stress; Previous two easy runs felt genuinely easy by talk test Skip if: Strap signal has been unreliable; Legs feel flat or sore from lifting/running; Weather is unusually hot/humid; You feel tempted to race the test After the run, log: Test option used: Garmin guided / 30-min field test / skipped; HR source: Garmin chest strap required; Chest strap signal quality: clean / dropouts / spikes; If field test: average HR for final 20 minutes; If Garmin guided: detected LTHR and pace, if provided; Perceived control: did you blow up, negative split, or stay even?; Weather and surface; Recommendation: update zones now / wait for more data / retest later

exercises.label: Warm-up
exercises.detail: Easy running only. Finish with relaxed breathing and no leg heaviness.

exercises.label: Primer strides
exercises.detail: Relaxed fast strides with 60-90 sec easy jog/walk between. These prime mechanics, not fitness.

exercises.label: Option A: Garmin guided LTHR test
exercises.detail: If your watch supports the guided Lactate Threshold Test, use that and follow the watch prompts with the chest strap connected.

exercises.label: Option B: 30-minute field test
exercises.detail: Hard-controlled and even. Do not sprint the first 10 min. Average HR for final 20 min is the rough LTHR estimate.

exercises.label: Cooldown
exercises.detail: Easy jog/walk until breathing is normal. No extra mileage chase.

routine_specs.name: Four-Week Running Calibration — Patched
routine_specs.notes:
Patched version: Garmin chest strap required for calibration-quality HR; Week 1 is easy-only baseline; Week 3 includes one optional diagnostic LTHR test with easy fallback. Regular threshold training remains excluded.

Baseline source: running-last-7-days.md. Baseline week: 49.05 miles; Seven consecutive runs, mostly 6-7 miles, with a 9-mile long run. Zone caveat: User reports Garmin zones likely read too hard. This patched bundle treats Garmin HR zones as observation data only until chest-strap data and one optional LTHR test provide a better anchor. Training priority: Calibration and consistency, not performance improvement. HR calibration policy: Garmin chest heart-rate strap for every calibration-quality run. If the strap is not used, mark the run as useful mileage but non-calibration-quality HR data. Do not rewrite zones after one odd run. Review after 10-14 days of strap data, then use Garmin guided LTHR test or field-test result as the main anchor. Calibration phases: Week 1: Easy-only baseline, strap validation, HR drift and talk-test audit. Strides are allowed because they are neuromuscular and fully recovered.; Week 2: First controlled steady-aerobic exposure if strap data is clean and easy effort is stable.; Week 3: Optional diagnostic LTHR calibration test. This is a test, not the beginning of threshold training.; Week 4: Deload, review zone settings, and decide the next real training block..

Intensity definitions: RPE 1-2: Recovery. Nose breathing may be possible but not required. Full conversation. You should feel better after than before.; RPE 2-3: Easy aerobic. Full-sentence talk test. Breathing present but calm. You could continue a long time.; RPE 3-4: Steady aerobic. Sentences still possible, but not casual storytelling. No burning legs; no threshold chasing.; RPE 4-5: Upper aerobic audit only. Short sentences, controlled. During this calibration block, do not let this become a race.; 6+: Avoid sustained RPE 6+ in this block. Strides may briefly touch fast mechanics, but recover fully between them.; diagnostic_lthr_test: One controlled diagnostic test only, preferably Garmin guided LTHR. Alternative: 30 min hard-controlled field test, using average HR from the final 20 min as a rough LTHR estimate. This is not a weekly threshold workout.

Weekly targets: Week 1: 46.5 mi, strap validation and easy-only baseline, 1 stride day, no steady/threshold, 1 long easy run; Week 2: 48.0 mi, small extension with first controlled aerobic check, 1 stride day, 1 easy-to-steady progression if strap data is clean, 1 long run; Week 3: 49.0 mi, highest calibration load plus optional diagnostic LTHR test, 1 stride day, 1 optional LTHR test or fallback steady audit, 1 long run; Week 4: 42.5 mi, deload, zone review, and next-block decision, reduced stride dose, short steady check only if fresh, reduced long run
